manual_method: Computed opaque foreground with conservative radial-gradient bounds between pale/panel. All endpoint RGB channels are componentwise ordered; label/readout areas are separate from molecular canvas. SVG axes were checked against panels and inspected for sibling overlap. No screenreader or per-pixel WCAG certification.
